messages:
Elena (AE): Hey team, AcmeBio POC running Private deployment — they're stuck on getting interface endpoints + egress/DNS right. Asked for a concise checklist we can share: subnets/route tables for the VPC endpoint, SG/NACL guidance, whether we need static egress IPs, and how we can issue a short-lived API key for the POC. Any immediate blockers?
Devon (Solutions): Quick checklist from our side: 1) Create an Interface VPC Endpoint (AWS) for our endpoint service name we provide; pick subnets in 2 AZs. 2) Security group on the endpoint: allow inbound 443 from your app subnets. 3) DNS: enable private DNS for the endpoint so service domain resolves to the VPCE. 4) Routing/egress: endpoint ENIs don't need route table changes, but app subnets must be able to reach the ENI (no overly restrictive SG/NACL). If the app is in private subnets that require internet for bootstrap (e.g., pulling container images), add NATGW or S3 endpoints for artifacts.
Patrick (Infra): To clarify: we don't publish static public IPs for the control plane. For PrivateLink the traffic stays in the fabric — customer creates the VPCE, we accept the connection from our side. We need their VPCE service name + account ID to complete acceptance. For any control-plane callbacks (if they opt-in) we ask for outbound 443 allowed to our service domain via the VPCE.
Megan (Security): Security notes: prefer SG-based allowlists, not NACLs, since NACLs can be confusing with ephemeral ENIs. Make sure the VPCE private DNS is enabled and the customer's resolver doesn't override names (split-horizon). Also confirm they won't intercept TLS: we expect end-to-end TLS to our certs. For POC keys: we can issue a scoped API key (limited models, low quota) via support ticket — no broad org keys.
Elena (AE): Customer also asked whether we can put an A/ALIAS record in their private hosted zone to point to the VPCE DNS name — is that needed or will the AWS private DNS auto-resolve?
Devon (Solutions): If they enable the endpoint's Private DNS option AWS will map the service hostname to the VPCE automatically. Only create a hosted-zone record if they have a custom internal domain; then you'd create a CNAME/ALIAS to the vpce DNS name.
Elena (AE): Can you paste a tiny Terraform snippet we can give them to create the interface endpoint?
Devon (Solutions): Sure — paste this to share (they can adapt AZs/subnet ids):
```
resource "aws_vpc_endpoint" "redwood_inference" {
  vpc_id            = "vpc-0123456789"
  service_name      = "com.amazonaws.vpce.us-west-2.vpce-svc-abcdef123456" # replace with our service name we provide
  vpc_endpoint_type = "Interface"
  subnet_ids        = ["subnet-aaa","subnet-bbb"]
  security_group_ids = ["sg-allow-vpce"]
  private_dns_enabled = true
}
```
Patrick (Infra): Ops checklist for them: - Ensure route tables for the subnets have no egress blocks to the ENI. - If using strict host-based firewalls, allow outbound 443 to the VPCE ENI IPs (ephemeral). - Share account ID so we can accept the endpoint.
Ryan (Sales): On the dedicated pool question: for POC we can simulate a small dedicated environment but provisioning dedicated GPUs requires a short contract. For immediate testing we can provide a scoped POC API key that hits our hosted-backed endpoint over the VPCE. We should surface pricing: POC tokens usage will be billed on normal hosted rates unless we agree otherwise.
sre-bot: Ticket #S-48321 created: "AcmeBio VPCE acceptance + POC API key" — assigned to Devon and Patrick.
Megan (Security): Also ask customer to run a quick DNS check after they create the VPCE: `dig +short api.redwood-inference.internal` (replace with the service hostname we send) and confirm it resolves to a private IP. If it still resolves to public IPs, they likely disabled private DNS.
Elena (AE): Great — I'll send this checklist + the Terraform snippet and ask for their subnet IDs, account ID, and whether they need a scoped API key. Can someone own the acceptance step once they provide the VPCE? @Patrick please?
Patrick (Infra): I got it — I'll take acceptance and verify the VPCE once they post the VPCE ID here.
Elena (AE): Thanks everyone. I'll ping again once they share details and schedule a 30m handoff. :thumbsup:
